title.en: Key-handling fixes for first run, sign-in, and sign-out

body.zh-TW:
初次啟動等待瀏覽器登入或貼上驗證碼，按 `Esc` 現在可以退回上一個畫面，不再完全沒反應。

在全螢幕模式執行 `/logout` 離開後，畫面上現在會保留已登出的訊息，不會空空如也。

在登入或設定步驟連按 `Ctrl+C` 或 `Ctrl+D` 離開後，Shell 提示字元不再疊印在最後一個畫面上。

初次挑選主題或遇到背景工作階段的啟動提問時，連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 也不會再沒反應或卡死終端機。
body.en:
While first-run sign-in waits for the browser or a pasted code, pressing `Esc` now goes back one screen instead of doing nothing.

After running `/logout` in fullscreen mode, the screen now keeps the logged-out message visible instead of exiting blank.

After quitting a sign-in or setup step with `Ctrl+C` or `Ctrl+D`, the shell prompt is no longer drawn over the last screen.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` twice during the first-run theme choice or at a background session's startup question no longer does nothing or freezes the terminal.

items.original:
Fixed Esc doing nothing while the first-run sign-in waits for the browser or a pasted code; it now goes back one screen
Fixed `/logout` in fullscreen mode exiting without leaving the logged-out message on screen
Fixed the shell prompt being drawn over the last screen after quitting with Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D at a sign-in or first-run step
Fixed Ctrl+C twice doing nothing on the first-run theme choice, and freezing the terminal on setup screens or a background session at its startup question

title.zh-TW: 修正 /privacy-settings 切換與多帳號錯存
title.en: /privacy-settings toggle and multi-account save fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 `/privacy-settings` 或啟動時拒絕更新條款，儲存期間誤按按鍵不會再把你的關閉選擇蓋掉。

快速連按兩次切換開關時，不會再出現畫面與實際存檔相反的狀況；按 `Esc` 後誤觸按鍵也不會改到設定，存檔失敗時則會明確通知。

若在另一個終端機切換登入帳號，`/privacy-settings` 不會存錯帳號；先開再關時也不會誤顯示已設為開啟。
body.en:
When declining updated terms in `/privacy-settings` or at startup, keys pressed while saving no longer overwrite your OFF choice.

A quick double press on the toggle no longer saves the opposite of what the screen shows. Pressing keys after `Esc` no longer changes your setting either, and failed saves now notify you clearly.

If you switch accounts in another terminal, `/privacy-settings` no longer saves to the wrong account, and picking OFF right after ON no longer wrongly shows it as enabled.

items.original:
Fixed your OFF answer to the updated terms being replaced when keys were typed while it was saving, at startup and in `/privacy-settings`
Fixed the `/privacy-settings` toggle sometimes saving the opposite of what the screen showed on a quick double press, changing your setting on keys pressed after Esc, and not saying when a save failed
Fixed `/privacy-settings` saving your choice on the wrong account after signing in to a different account in another terminal
Fixed `/privacy-settings` saying "set to true" when you picked OFF right after ON

title.zh-TW: 用量上限選單防誤觸與額度重置提示改善
title.en: Usage limit menu safeguards and budget reset notices

body.zh-TW:
開啟支出上限選單後，剛打開就按 `Backspace` 和 `Enter` 不再默默清掉每月上限；用量上限選單也不會在你打字中途突然跳出來清光草稿。

用量上限重置後，舊上限訊息底下不會再跳出升級提示。團隊共用額度用盡時，訊息現在會寫明額度何時重置。

執行 `/usage-credits` 被拒時，若你自己就有帳務權限，畫面會改引導你前往用量設定頁，不再一律顯示已送交管理員。
body.en:
Pressing `Backspace` and `Enter` right as the spend limit menu opens no longer silently clears your monthly limit. The usage limit menu also no longer pops up while you are typing and wipes your draft.

After a usage limit resets, an upgrade hint no longer appears under old limit messages. When a team's pooled budget runs out, the message now states when the budget resets.

When `/usage-credits` is refused and you have billing access yourself, the screen now points you to the usage settings page instead of always saying the request was sent to your admin.

items.original:
Fixed the spend limit menu removing the monthly limit without asking when Backspace and Enter were pressed as it opened
Fixed the usage limit menu erasing your draft and opening while you were typing
Fixed `/usage-credits` saying "Request sent to your admin" when the request was refused; people who have billing access themselves are now pointed to the usage settings page
Fixed an upgrade hint appearing under an old usage limit message after the limit had reset
Improved the message shown when a team's pooled group budget is used up: it now says when the budget resets

title.zh-TW: 額度等待中變更登入與 /usage 順序調整
title.en: Login changes while waiting on limits and /usage order

body.zh-TW:
設定「達用量上限時自動繼續」後，如果在等待期間切換帳號或登出，Claude Code 現在會跳出通知並直接停止，不會繼續送出任何請求。

訂閱用戶在全螢幕模式輸入 `/usage` 時，現在會先看到方案用量長條圖，再看到工作階段花費；想先看花費，輸入 `/cost` 就好。

使用額外用量點數計費的回覆結束後，Claude Code 不再自動送出工作階段回顧，需要時手動輸入 `/recap` 就能看。
body.en:
With "Continue automatically at usage limit" enabled, switching accounts or signing out during the wait now makes Claude Code show a notice and stop immediately without sending any requests.

For subscribers running `/usage` in fullscreen mode, plan limit bars now appear before session cost. If you want to see cost first, run `/cost` instead.

After a reply billed to usage credits finishes, Claude Code no longer sends an automatic session recap; you can still run `/recap` manually when needed.

items.original:
Changed "Continue automatically at usage limit" to stop with a notice, sending nothing, when your login changes or ends during the wait
Changed `/usage` in fullscreen mode to show plan limit bars before session cost for subscribers; `/cost` still starts with cost
Fixed the automatic session recap being sent after a reply billed to usage credits; `/recap` still works

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援即時串流與連線調整
title.en: Remote Control live streaming and connection updates

body.zh-TW:
打開遠端遙控後，`claude remote-control`、Claude Desktop 與 VS Code 的工作階段回覆，現在會邊寫邊串流到手機或瀏覽器。你不用等到整段跑完才看得到內容。

連線經由 Proxy 時，Remote Control 改用 CONNECT 通道送出請求；若 Proxy 拒絕 CONNECT，會直接報錯停止。

開啟 `--verbose` 產生的遠端工作階段除錯紀錄，現在會改存到 `~/.claude/child-logs/`。⟦看體育比賽的即時文字轉播時，不用等整場結束發新聞稿，現場每打一行字，手機就馬上跳出來。⟧
body.en:
With Remote Control enabled, session replies from `claude remote-control`, Claude Desktop, and VS Code now stream to your phone or browser as they are written. You no longer have to wait for the full response to finish.

When connecting through a proxy, Remote Control now sends requests over a CONNECT tunnel, and stops with an error if the proxy refuses CONNECT.

Remote session debug logs generated under `--verbose` are now saved to `~/.claude/child-logs/`. ⟦Following a live text play-by-play of a sports match means each line typed at the venue pops up on your phone right away instead of waiting for a post-game press release.⟧

items.original:
Improved Remote Control: replies from `claude remote-control`, Claude Desktop and VS Code sessions now stream to your phone or browser as they are written
Remote Control: Changed how it connects through a proxy: requests now use a CONNECT tunnel, so a proxy that refuses CONNECT stops Remote Control with an error
Remote Control: Changed the session debug logs written under `--verbose` to go to `~/.claude/child-logs/`

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 狀態、QR Code 與中止修復
title.en: Remote Control status, QR code, and Stop fixes

body.zh-TW:
伺服器短暫無回應時，Remote Control 工作階段不會再於回覆寫到一半斷線。在 80×24 這類較矮的終端機視窗，`/remote-control` 的 QR Code 也不再被截斷。

背景子代理還在跑時，手機端不再誤顯示為待機，在手機或網頁按 Stop 會連同子代理一起停掉。

遇到只能在終端機回答的提示，或工具執行中才開遙控時，狀態也不會再顛倒顯示；重啟期間按過 Stop，重開後不會又自己續跑。
body.en:
Remote Control sessions no longer disconnect mid-reply when the server is briefly unavailable. In short terminal windows such as 80×24, the `/remote-control` QR code is no longer cut off either.

While background subagents are still running, your phone no longer wrongly shows the session as idle, and pressing Stop on your phone or the web ends the subagents too.

Status is no longer inverted when waiting on a prompt that can only be answered in the terminal or when turning on Remote Control while a tool is running. Pressing Stop during a restart also prevents the reply from resuming on its own afterward.

items.original:
Remote Control: Fixed a session disconnecting mid-reply when the server was briefly unavailable
Remote Control: Fixed the QR code in `/remote-control` being cut off in short terminal windows such as 80×24
Remote Control: Fixed terminal sessions showing as idle on your phone while background subagents were still running; Stop on your phone or the web now ends them together with the turn
Fixed Remote Control showing a session as running while it waited on a prompt that can only be answered in the terminal, and as idle when turned on while a tool was running
Fixed a reply in a remote session running again after a restart when Stop had been pressed while Claude Code was restarting

title.zh-TW: 雲端與遠端傳檔重試、檔案保留與通知遮罩
title.en: Cloud and remote file upload retries, preservation, and notification masking

body.zh-TW:
在未載入任何功能旗標的 Linux 環境中，遠端或雲端工作階段若重送同名檔案，不再直接蓋掉 Claude 改過的版本；舊檔會移到 `.kept-` 資料夾，或選擇不存新檔。

Claude 從雲端或 Remote Control 傳送檔案時，若碰到 Proxy 回傳 HTTP 502、504 或 520 到 524 錯誤，現在會再重試一次，不會立刻失敗。

遠端與雲端工作的推播通知也強化了敏感資訊遮罩；經遙控從終端機要求使用 Chrome 擴充時，claude.ai 就算已核准該網站，仍會明確顯示網站名稱。
body.en:
On Linux with no feature flags loaded, re-sending a file with the same name in Remote Control or cloud sessions no longer overwrites Claude's edited copy; the old copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file is not saved.

When Claude sends files from cloud or Remote Control sessions and a proxy responds with HTTP 502, 504, or 520 to 524, it now retries once instead of failing immediately.

Push notifications from Remote Control and cloud sessions also have stronger secret masking. When requesting Chrome extension access from a terminal session over Remote Control, claude.ai still names the site clearly even if it is already allowed.

items.original:
Fixed a re-sent file overwriting Claude's changed copy in Remote Control and cloud sessions on Linux with no feature flags loaded: the copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file isn't saved
Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when a proxy answers an upload with its own HTTP 502, 504 or 520 to 524; the upload now gets a second try
Improved how secrets are masked in push notifications from Remote Control and cloud sessions
Improved Claude in Chrome permission requests from a terminal session over Remote Control: on claude.ai they now name the site Claude wants to act on, also when it is already allowed

title.zh-TW: claude.ai 與 Cowork 傳檔金鑰檢查修復
title.en: Fixes for file-sending key checks in claude.ai and Cowork

body.zh-TW:
在 claude.ai 對話或 Cowork 任務傳送檔案，跳出私密金鑰檢查後就算你點了「Send it」，過去仍可能沒把檔案送出去，現在已經修好。

遇到裡面包著 Word、Excel 或其他壓縮格式的外掛檔時，介面不再只因為格式就反覆詢問，而是會先實際讀取內容確認有沒有金鑰。
body.en:
Fixed an issue where sending a file in a claude.ai chat or Cowork task could still fail to send even after you clicked "Send it" at the secret key check.

When a plugin file contains a Word, Excel, or other compressed file, the interface no longer prompts repeatedly just because of the format, and instead reads the contents first to check for keys.

items.original:
Fixed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks sometimes not sending a file after you chose "Send it" at the check for secret keys
Fixed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks asking about a plugin file only because it holds a Word, Excel or other zip-type file; such files are now read for secret keys first

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器權限收緊與內建 gh api 調整
title.en: Tighter self-hosted runner permissions and built-in gh api updates

body.zh-TW:
用 `claude self-hosted-runner` 時，若機器時間跑得比實際快而讓更新 token 看起來已過期，過去會陷入不停要新 token 的死循環，現在已經修好。

在 `--trust-workspace false` 模式下，自架執行器現在會忽略更多儲存庫本身的設定，有需要的設定請改寫在使用者或組織管理設定裡。

Linux 與 macOS 工作階段若沒有 `gh`，預設會經 Anthropic 提供內建 `gh api`，有登入時會帶入你的 GitHub 帳號。想關閉這項預設，執行時加上 `--use-anthropic-gh false` 即可。
body.en:
Fixed an infinite loop when using `claude self-hosted-runner` where it kept requesting new tokens nonstop if the machine's clock ran ahead and made a refreshed token look expired.

Under `--trust-workspace false`, self-hosted runners now ignore more repository settings; put any needed settings in user or organization managed settings instead.

If `gh` is missing in Linux and macOS sessions, a built-in `gh api` is now provided via Anthropic by default, using your GitHub sign-in if you are logged in. To turn this default off, run with `--use-anthropic-gh false`.

items.original:
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` asking for new tokens nonstop when a refreshed token was already due, such as when the machine's clock runs ahead
Changed self-hosted runners under `--trust-workspace false` to ignore more repository settings; set such values in user or managed settings
Self-hosted runner: Changed Linux and macOS sessions with no `gh` to get a built-in `gh api` by default, via Anthropic, which adds their GitHub sign-in, if any; `--use-anthropic-gh false` turns it off

title.zh-TW: 雲端中止加速與遠端「永遠允許」儲存調整
title.en: Faster cloud stop and remote "always allow" saving updates

body.zh-TW:
在雲端或自架執行器工作階段按下 Stop 時，過去偶爾會卡著等緩慢的 MCP 伺服器連上線才真的停下來，這個問題已經修好，現在能更快中止。

透過 Remote Control 或自架執行器回覆權限請求時，調整了選擇「永遠允許」後的儲存方式。
body.en:
Fixed an issue where pressing Stop in cloud or self-hosted runner sessions could occasionally hang waiting for slow MCP servers to connect before actually stopping, so it now aborts faster.

Adjusted how "always allow" choices are saved when answering permission requests through Remote Control or on self-hosted runners.

items.original:
Fixed Stop in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions sometimes waiting for slow MCP servers to connect before taking effect
Changed how permission answers over Remote Control and on self-hosted runners save "always allow" choices

title.zh-TW: /autofix-pr、/teleport 與跨機傳訊調整
title.en: Updates to /autofix-pr, /teleport, and cross-machine messaging

body.zh-TW:
使用 `/autofix-pr` 若遇到無法停止的雲端工作階段，現在不再誤報為已取消，而是附上該工作階段連結讓你自己手動停掉。

在寬度較窄的終端機裡開啟 `/teleport` 時，清單裡的工作階段不會再被隱藏起來。

如果你在保留舊 claude.ai 登入狀態的同時改用 API 金鑰、驗證 token、設定檔或工作負載身分，Claude 現在會拒絕把訊息送到另一台機器上的工作階段。
body.en:
When `/autofix-pr` hits a cloud session that cannot be stopped, it no longer falsely reports the run as cancelled and instead includes a link to the session so you can stop it manually.

Opening `/teleport` in narrow terminals no longer hides sessions from the list.

If you switch to an API key, auth token, profile, or workload identity while keeping an older claude.ai login saved, Claude now refuses to send messages to a session on another machine.

items.original:
Fixed `/autofix-pr` reporting a run as cancelled when its cloud session could not be stopped; it now links the session so you can stop it
Fixed `/teleport` hiding a session from its list in narrow terminals
Changed Claude's messages to a session on another machine to be refused when your session uses an API key, auth token, profile or workload identity beside a saved claude.ai login

title.zh-TW: 產出物發布權限、存取說明與連結顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for artifact publishing permissions, access labels, and link display

body.zh-TW:
發佈產出物時，放在背景工作階段暫存資料夾裡的檔案過去會被拒絕，現在可以正常發佈。終端機在 Claude 發佈或更新產出物後，也會確實印出連結。

部分雲端工作階段裡，就算子代理的 `disallowedTools` 明確禁用了 `Artifact`，過去還是會拿到產出物工具，現在已經修好。

剛發佈的產出物只要資料夾有權限的人都能開，Claude 也不會再誤說它是私密的。
body.en:
Files in a background session's temporary folder are no longer refused when publishing artifacts. The terminal also properly prints the link after Claude publishes or updates an artifact.

Fixed an issue in some cloud sessions where subagents still received artifact tools even when `Artifact` was explicitly listed in `disallowedTools`.

Anyone with access to the folder can open a just-published artifact, and Claude no longer mistakenly calls it private.

items.original:
Fixed artifact publishing refusing files in a background session's temporary folder
Fixed subagents whose `disallowedTools` lists `Artifact` still being offered artifact tools in some cloud sessions
Fixed Claude calling a just-published artifact private when people with access to its folder can open it
Fixed the terminal not showing an artifact's link after Claude publishes or updates it

title.zh-TW: Worktree 建立進度與離開統計修復
title.en: Fixes for worktree setup progress and exit counts

body.zh-TW:
用 `claude --worktree` 開啟 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，建立較慢現在會顯示進度。畫面不會再一片空白讓你乾等。

關閉 worktree 的離開確認視窗時，新建的資料夾不再被算成一個未提交檔案。

部分 worktree 工作階段會略過某些外掛設定，畫面也會明確列出被略過的項目。
body.en:
When opening a worktree (a Git feature that lets you keep parallel copies of the same project) with `claude --worktree`, slow setup now shows progress. The screen no longer stays blank while you wait.

Closing the worktree exit confirmation dialog no longer counts a newly created folder as one uncommitted file.

Some worktree sessions now skip certain plugin settings, and the screen clearly lists what was skipped.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --worktree` showing nothing while a slow worktree is set up
Fixed the worktree exit dialog counting a new folder as one uncommitted file
Changed some worktree sessions to skip some plugin settings; a notice names what was skipped

title.zh-TW: Worktree 子代理分支安全與清理限制
title.en: Worktree subagent branch safety and cleanup limits

body.zh-TW:
被隔離在 worktree 裡的子代理，現在在任何儲存庫都禁止透過 Bash 執行可能改寫共用分支的 git 指令；一般工作階段不受影響。

只要 worktree 裡還有背景子代理或殼層指令可能正在執行，`ExitWorktree` 就會拒絕移除該 worktree，除非 Claude 主動傳入 `discard_changes`。

建立 worktree、使用 `/teleport` 或 IDE 檢出時，現在會用更嚴格的 `PATH` 執行 git，自訂的 git 過濾器或輔助程式可能需要填寫完整路徑。⟦分房獨立寫草稿時，不准直接改掉大家共用的總目錄，裡面還有人在工作時退房也不會直接拆屋清空。⟧
body.en:
Subagents isolated in a worktree are now blocked from running git commands in Bash that could rewrite shared branches in any repository; regular sessions are unaffected.

As long as a background subagent or shell command might still be running in a worktree, `ExitWorktree` refuses to remove it unless Claude explicitly passes `discard_changes`.

Creating a worktree, using `/teleport`, or running IDE checkouts now invokes git with a stricter `PATH`, so custom git filters or helpers may need their full path. ⟦Writers drafting in separate rooms are not allowed to alter everyone's shared master index directly, and checking out while someone is still inside will not tear down and clear the room.⟧

items.original:
Changed subagents isolated in a worktree to refuse, in any repository, some git commands in Bash that can rewrite branches shared with your checkout; sessions are not affected
Changed `ExitWorktree` to refuse removing a worktree while a background subagent or shell command may still be running in it, unless Claude passes `discard_changes`
Changed worktree creation, `/teleport` and IDE checkouts to run git with a stricter `PATH`; a git filter or helper may need its full path

title.zh-TW: 背景工作階段的閘道保留與行程誤殺修復
title.en: Fixes for background session gateway retention and process mis-kills

body.zh-TW:
你在終端機匯出的 LLM 閘道，過去在背景執行遇到當機、從別的資料夾重開，或背景服務缺少它時會遺失；現在會先在送出任何模型請求前停下來，不會錯連。

背景服務清查程序時，若列表上的程序編號剛好被其他使用者的程序重複使用（例如你的 SSH 登入），過去竟會誤殺你自己的程序，現在已經修好。

當你開啟、停止或移除背景工作階段所接續的那個舊工作階段時，背景工作階段不會再一起被殺掉並弄丟請求。非互動執行或背景代理若權限檢查出錯，訊息也會點出原因。
body.en:
An LLM gateway exported in your terminal previously got lost in background runs after a crash, after reopening from another folder, or when the background service lacked it; sessions now stop before sending any model request instead of connecting to the wrong place.

Fixed an issue where the background service's process cleanup could mistakenly kill your own process (such as your SSH login) if a process ID on its list had been reused by another user's process.

Opening, stopping, or removing the older session that a background session resumed no longer kills the background session and loses its request. If a permission check errors out in non-interactive runs or background agents, the message now names the cause.

items.original:
Fixed background sessions losing the LLM gateway your shell exported after a crash, after a reopen from another folder, or when the background service lacks it: they now stop before any model request
Fixed the background service ending your own processes, such as an SSH login, when a process number on its list had been reused by another user's process
Fixed a background session being killed and its request lost when you opened, stopped or removed the older session whose conversation it had resumed
Improved the message in non-interactive runs and background agents when a permission check fails with an error, so it names the cause

title.zh-TW: 背景執行參數與 --bare 金鑰限制
title.en: Background flags and --bare key restrictions

body.zh-TW:
`--bare` 工作階段若用未經核准的 API 金鑰，多數環境現在會拒絕把它移到背景。若跑 `claude --bare --bg` 而背景服務沒有那把金鑰，也會直接報錯退出。

由於 `--bg` 與 `--worktree --tmux` 從來不會讀取初始化請求，現在只要同時帶上 `--await-initialize` 就會直接拒絕啟動，不再漏掉欄位硬跑。⟦寄件時若選了無人領取的自助櫃，卻還硬勾「當面簽收」，現在櫃檯會直接提醒不合理並退回，不再漏掉資料硬寄。⟧
body.en:
If a `--bare` session uses an unapproved API key, most setups now refuse moving it to the background. Running `claude --bare --bg` when the background service lacks that key also exits with an error.

Because `--bg` and `--worktree --tmux` never read the initialize request, passing `--await-initialize` alongside them is now refused at startup instead of running with missing fields. ⟦Sending a parcel to an unmanned pickup locker while still checking "sign in person" now makes the counter flag the contradiction and turn it away, rather than shipping it out with missing details.⟧

items.original:
Changed `--bare` sessions on an unapproved API key: moving one to the background is now refused in most setups, and `claude --bare --bg` exits with an error if the background service lacks the key
Changed `--await-initialize` to be refused with `--bg` or `--worktree --tmux`, which never read the initialize request, instead of starting without the fields it carries

title.zh-TW: 子代理回報對象、工具計數與多代理效能改善
title.en: Subagent reporting targets, tool counts, and multi-agent performance

body.zh-TW:
終端機主對話在等一個曾被其他子代理傳訊聯絡的背景子代理時，不再傻傻乾等，現在會得知它究竟向誰回報。

在離開對話連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 或介面當掉結束工作階段時，背景代理不會再誤以為是你拒絕了它的工具呼叫。

在 auto mode 統計子代理工具次數時，不再把交最終報告的那一通算進去。工作流程恢復若遇到失敗，也會告訴 Claude 重用了幾筆結果與在哪停下。

同時跑超過 20 個子代理時，未開啟紀錄的背景代理改為每 5 秒更新一次 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數，降低 CPU 負擔。
body.en:
When the main terminal conversation is waiting on a background subagent that another subagent messaged, it no longer waits blindly and is now told which agent the subagent reports to.

When a session ends after pressing `Ctrl+C` twice at the exit dialog or after an interface crash, background agents are no longer told you refused their tool call.

Subagent tool counts in auto mode no longer include the call that delivers the final report. When workflow resume hits a failure, it also tells Claude how many results were reused and where reuse stopped.

When more than 20 subagents run at once, background agents without an open transcript now update their token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) counts every 5 seconds to reduce CPU load.

items.original:
Fixed the main conversation of a terminal session waiting in silence for a background subagent that another subagent had messaged: it's now told which agent the subagent reports to
Fixed background agents being told you refused their tool call when a session ended by Ctrl+C twice at the exit dialog, or after an interface crash
Fixed subagent tool counts in auto mode including the call that delivers the agent's final report
Fixed workflow resume telling Claude every finished agent would be reused after a call failed; Claude is now told how many results were reused and where reuse stopped
Improved CPU use when more than 20 subagents are running: token counts of background agents whose transcript isn't open now update every 5 seconds

title.zh-TW: 輸入框下的代理與背景指令狀態列修復
title.en: Agent and background command status row fixes under the prompt

body.zh-TW:
代理明明已經講完一輪，輸入框下方那列卻還一直顯示忙碌。現在會寫明它在等什麼，`/tasks` 也會標出每個背景指令背後的子代理名稱。

已停止或失敗的代理不會再看起來像還在跑，平行執行時也不會誤標為「Done」，停掉的代理最後一道指令也不會繼續顯示「Running…」。

展開的背景代理重試請求時，不會再只轉普通圈圈。單輪啟動三個以上代理時，「background agents launched」不會只算到兩個；先前的「done」列也不再行行都顯示還有背景殼層在跑。
body.en:
When an agent finished its turn, the row under the prompt still showed it as busy. Now it states what it is waiting on, and `/tasks` names the subagent behind each background command.

Stopped or failed agents no longer look like they are still running or show "Done" when run in parallel, and a stopped agent's last command no longer stays on "Running…".

Expanded background agents no longer show a plain spinner while retrying requests. When three or more agents launch in one turn, "background agents launched" no longer stops at two, and earlier "done" rows no longer all show a background shell still running.

items.original:
Fixed the agent rows under the prompt showing an agent as busy after its turn ended: the row now says what it is waiting on, and `/tasks` names the subagent behind each background command
Fixed stopped and failed agents looking like running ones in the agent rows under the prompt, or showing "Done" when run in parallel, and a stopped agent's last command still showing "Running…"
Fixed an opened background agent showing a normal spinner while its requests were being retried
Fixed the "background agents launched" line stopping at two when Claude starts three or more agents in one reply
Fixed every earlier turn's "done" line showing "1 shell still running" while a background task ran

title.zh-TW: 檢視子代理時的提示、貼圖與版面修復
title.en: Subagent view hint, image paste, and layout fixes

body.zh-TW:
進到子代理檢視且按下 `Esc` 就能停掉它時，底部現在會顯示 `esc to stop` 提示。

查看子代理或隊友時，按 `↑` 或 `Esc` 不再把主對話排隊訊息搬進它的輸入框。非全螢幕頂端的歡迎標題，現在也會正確顯示該子代理實際使用的模型，不再套用主工作階段的模型。

查看背景代理時貼上的圖片，不會再只變成 `[Image #1]` 純文字。較長的背景代理與背景指令結果換行時，也會對齊文字開頭，不再折到項目符號下方。
body.en:
When you are in a subagent view where pressing `Esc` can stop it, the footer now shows an `esc to stop` hint.

While viewing a subagent or teammate, pressing `↑` or `Esc` no longer moves queued messages from the main conversation into its prompt box. Outside fullscreen mode, the welcome header at the top now shows the model that subagent actually uses instead of the main session's model.

Images pasted while viewing a background agent no longer arrive as plain text `[Image #1]`. Long background agent and background command results now wrap aligned with the start of their text instead of under the bullet.

items.original:
Added an `esc to stop` footer hint in a subagent's view where Esc would stop it
Fixed Up and Esc moving the main conversation's queued messages into the prompt box of a subagent or teammate you are viewing
Fixed the welcome header outside fullscreen mode showing the session's model while viewing a subagent or teammate that runs on a different model
Fixed images pasted while viewing a background agent arriving as the text `[Image #1]`
Fixed long background agent and background command results wrapping under the bullet instead of lining up with their text

title.zh-TW: 代理檢視操作、退場與核准計畫選單調整
title.en: Agent view controls, exit behavior, and plan approval menu updates

body.zh-TW:
代理檢視的選擇器現在支援 `Home`、`End` 與翻頁鍵；代理檢視與輸入框下方的代理列，也統一用和其他清單一樣的指標與顏色標示選中項目。

用 `Ctrl+C` 停掉背景代理後，只要清單仍有停下的子代理，底部會提示 `↓ to resume subagent`。空對話按 `←` 後再用 `Ctrl+C` 兩次、`Ctrl+D` 兩次或 `/exit`，會直接結束該工作階段，不再放著跑 5 分鐘。

核准子代理計畫的卡片現在只留「是，並於本工作階段改回預設每次詢問」與「否」兩個選項，用方向鍵與 Enter 選取。
body.en:
Pickers in agent view now support `Home`, `End`, and paging keys. Both agent view and the agent rows under the prompt now mark the selected item with the same pointer and color as other lists.

After stopping background agents with `Ctrl+C`, the footer offers `↓ to resume subagent` as long as a stopped subagent remains in the list. Pressing `←` in an empty conversation and then quitting with `Ctrl+C` twice, `Ctrl+D` twice, or `/exit` now ends that session immediately instead of leaving it running for 5 minutes.

The card for approving a subagent's plan now has only two choices, "Yes, and switch to default (ask each time) for this session" and "No", selected with the arrow keys and Enter.

items.original:
Improved the pickers in agent view to take Home, End and paging
Improved agent view and the agent rows under the prompt to mark the selected row with the same pointer and color as other lists
Improved the footer after Ctrl+C stops background agents: it now offers `↓ to resume subagent` while a stopped subagent is listed
Changed agent view so that quitting with Ctrl+C twice, Ctrl+D twice or `/exit` after pressing `←` in an empty conversation ends that session, instead of leaving it running for 5 minutes
Changed the card for approving a subagent's plan to two choices, "Yes, and switch to default (ask each time) for this session" and "No", chosen with the arrow keys and Enter (typed text moves to No)

title.zh-TW: /plugin 寬容載入外掛與移除方式調整
title.en: Tolerant /plugin loading and removal flow updates

body.zh-TW:
以前 `plugin.json` 的 `author` 或 `homepage` 等顯示欄位格式出錯，已啟用的外掛會直接拒載。現在外掛及其 hook、MCP 伺服器會照常載入，並在 `/plugin` 與 `claude plugin list` 提示哪個欄位被略過；管理員記得檢查部署的外掛。

解除安裝外掛時，若沒有其他外掛共用同一份 `.mcpb` 或 `.dxt` 套件，從中解壓的檔案也會一併刪除。

`/plugin` 裡的解除安裝、移除與切換確認問題，現在改用方向鍵配 Enter 或 `Esc` 取消，不再接受 `y`、`n`、`u` 按鍵。
body.en:
Previously, if a display field like `author` or `homepage` in `plugin.json` was malformed, enabled plugins were refused outright. Now the plugin, its hooks, and its MCP servers still load, while `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` note which field was ignored; administrators should check the plugins they deploy.

Uninstalling a plugin now also deletes files extracted from its `.mcpb` or `.dxt` bundle unless another plugin shares the same bundle.

Confirmation prompts for uninstalling, removing, and switching in `/plugin` now use the arrow keys with Enter, or `Esc` to cancel, and no longer accept `y`, `n`, or `u`.

items.original:
Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin list` when a malformed `plugin.json` field such as `author` or `homepage` is ignored
Changed enabled plugins that were refused for a malformed `plugin.json` display field: they now load, with their hooks and MCP servers; administrators should check the plugins they deploy
Changed plugin uninstall to also delete the files extracted from the plugin's MCP bundles (`.mcpb`, `.dxt`), unless another plugin uses the same bundle
Changed `/plugin` uninstall, remove and switch questions to lists answered with the arrow keys and Enter, or Esc to cancel; `y`, `n` and `u` no longer answer them

title.zh-TW: 外掛清單重複列、代理逾時與搜尋卡頓修復
title.en: Duplicate plugin rows, proxy timeout, and search cursor fixes

body.zh-TW:
設定檔、外掛市集或 Grep 檔案篩選條件若寫入格式錯誤的萬用字元模式，程式不再直接卡死。

當環境只設定 `ALL_PROXY` 且該 Proxy 完全沒回應時，外掛與市集請求不再無限空等，25 秒後就會結束失敗。

同一個位置有兩個同名技能或指令時，`/` 選單、`/skills` 與 `/plugin` 不再出現重複列或搞丟游標。清掉 `/plugin` 已安裝分頁的搜尋文字後，游標也不會再消失。
body.en:
Malformed glob patterns in settings, plugin marketplaces, or Grep file filters no longer hang the app.

When `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set and it never responds, plugin and marketplace requests no longer wait forever and now fail after 25 seconds.

When two skills or commands in the same location share a name, the `/` menu, `/skills`, and `/plugin` no longer show duplicate rows or lose the cursor. Clearing the search text on the `/plugin` Installed tab no longer makes the cursor disappear.

items.original:
Fixed a hang on malformed glob patterns in settings, plugin marketplace entries and Grep file filters
Fixed plugin and marketplace requests waiting forever when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set and the proxy never answers; they now fail after 25 seconds
Fixed the `/` menu, `/skills` and `/plugin` repeating rows and losing the cursor when two skills or commands in one place share a name
Fixed the cursor disappearing after clearing a search on the `/plugin` Installed tab

title.zh-TW: /plugin 各分頁支援滑鼠與鍵盤快速瀏覽
title.en: Mouse and keyboard navigation across /plugin tabs

body.zh-TW:
在 `/plugin` 的探索、市集與已安裝分頁中，現在都能使用 `Home`、`End`、`PgUp`、`PgDn` 與滑鼠點擊，探索和市集清單也支援滾輪，在矮視窗裡仍看得到游標與按鍵提示。

已安裝分頁會顯示隱藏列數；市集與新增市集分頁換成精簡清單、更清楚的移除確認與輸入框，新增失敗時的錯誤訊息也更精簡。

錯誤與統計分頁的長錯誤不再塞滿螢幕，從錯誤處點選移除會先詢問，過長的技能名稱也不會再把表格撐歪。
body.en:
In `/plugin`'s Discover, Marketplaces, and Installed tabs, `Home`, `End`, `PgUp`, `PgDn`, and mouse clicks now work, and the Discover and marketplace lists also support the mouse wheel while keeping the cursor and key hints visible in short windows.

The Installed tab now counts hidden rows. The Marketplaces and Add marketplace tabs get a compact list, a clearer remove confirmation and text field, and shorter error messages when adding fails.

Long errors on the Errors and Stats tabs no longer fill the screen, uninstalling from an error asks first, and overly long skill names no longer break the table layout.

items.original:
Improved `/plugin` Discover and marketplace lists: they fit short windows with the cursor and key hints on screen, and Home, End, PgUp, PgDn, the mouse wheel and clicks now work
Improved `/plugin` Marketplaces and Add marketplace: a compact list, a clearer remove confirmation, a clear text field and shorter errors when adding fails
Improved `/plugin` Installed tab: Home, End, PgUp, PgDn and clicks now work, and hidden rows are counted
Improved `/plugin` Errors and Stats tabs: long errors no longer fill the screen, uninstalling from an error asks first, and long skill names no longer break the table

title.zh-TW: /skills、/help 與 /claude-api 調整
title.en: /skills, /help, and /claude-api updates

body.zh-TW:
在 `/skills` 面板連按兩次 `Ctrl+C` 或 `Ctrl+D` 時，不再直接退出整個 Claude Code 並弄丟修改，現在會先存檔再關閉面板。

工作階段進行中新建立的第一個技能、指令或代理，現在立刻就能被找到。

輸入 `/clear --help` 這類內建指令時，不再於空閒提示列直接執行而是顯示用法，同時新增 `/help <command>` 查指令說明。

`/claude-api` 技能現在預設改以 Managed Agents 建置代理，除非你明確想自己託管代理迴圈。
body.en:
Pressing `Ctrl+C` or `Ctrl+D` twice in the `/skills` panel no longer quits all of Claude Code and drops changes; it now saves and closes the panel.

The first skill, command, or agent created during an active session can now be found right away.

Built-in commands like `/clear --help` now show usage instead of running at an idle prompt, and `/help <command>` has been added to look up command help.

The `/claude-api` skill now builds agents on Managed Agents by default unless you explicitly want to host the agent loop yourself.

items.original:
Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D twice in `/skills` quitting Claude Code and dropping changes; it now saves and closes the panel
Fixed a first skill, command or agent created during a session not being found right away
Fixed `/clear --help` and other built-in commands running at an idle prompt instead of showing usage; added `/help <command>`
Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build agents on Managed Agents by default, unless you want to host the agent loop yourself

title.zh-TW: 修正工作階段恢復漏記與 purge 隱藏提示
title.en: Session resume history and purge prompt fixes

body.zh-TW:
前一輪若以空白回覆收尾又發生當機，恢復工作階段時不再遺失最近幾輪對話；Claude Code 記憶體不足時，恢復工作階段也不再弄丟更早的對話紀錄。

執行 `claude purge` 且把輸出重導向時，確認提示過去會被藏起來，盲按一次 Enter 就可能刪光專案資料。現在這些確認提示都會正常顯示在終端機畫面上。
body.en:
Resuming a session after a crash no longer loses recent turns when the previous turn ended with an empty reply, nor does it lose earlier conversation history when Claude Code runs low on memory.

When running `claude purge` with output redirected, confirmation prompts used to be hidden, so a blind Enter press could wipe project data. Those confirmation prompts now show on the terminal.

items.original:
Fixed resumed sessions losing recent turns after a crash when the previous turn ended with an empty reply
Fixed resumed sessions losing earlier conversation history when Claude Code ran low on memory
Fixed `claude purge` hiding its prompts when stdout is redirected, where one unseen Enter could delete a project's data; they now show on the terminal

title.zh-TW: /rewind 分支還原與未追蹤變更提示修復
title.en: /rewind branch restore and untracked change fixes

body.zh-TW:
慢速備份還沒複製完就連跑兩次 `/branch` 後，再用 `/rewind` 過去只會還原部分檔案，現在能完整還原。

當殼層指令改了 `/rewind` 無法還原的檔案時，畫面不再誤寫「No code changes」。未追蹤變更的輪次，現在會改為顯示「Code changes unknown」。

在 `/rewind` 裡按 `Esc` 現在能取消摘要，全螢幕清單能顯示一筆以上的過去提問，長提問也不再擋住後續檔案遺失警告。
body.en:
Running `/rewind` after running `/branch` twice before a slow backup copy finished used to restore only some files; it now restores all of them.

When a shell command modifies files that `/rewind` cannot restore, it no longer falsely says "No code changes". Turns with untracked changes now display "Code changes unknown" instead.

In `/rewind`, pressing `Esc` now cancels the summary, the fullscreen list shows more than one past prompt, and long prompts no longer hide the warning about losing later file changes.

items.original:
Fixed `/rewind` restoring only some files after running `/branch` twice while a slow backup copy was still running
Fixed `/rewind` saying "No code changes" when a shell command changed files it can't restore; a turn whose changes weren't tracked now reads "Code changes unknown"
Fixed `/rewind`: Esc now cancels its summary, its list shows more than one past prompt in fullscreen, and a long prompt no longer hides its warning about losing later file changes

title.zh-TW: 修正 /plan、/goal 指令漏接與整批 PDF 誤刪
title.en: Fixes for /plan, /goal drops, and batch PDF removal

body.zh-TW:
已經處於規劃模式時，輸入 `/plan <description>` 過去會直接忽略後面的描述文字，現在已經修好。

同一個批次裡如果有另一份 PDF 被 API 退回，原本合格的其他 PDF 不會再連帶從對話中被清掉。

當 Stop hook 還在執行且背景工作仍在跑時，輸入 `/goal clear` 或新的 `/goal` 現在也能確實生效，不會再無聲漏接。
body.en:
Entering `/plan <description>` when plan mode was already on used to ignore the description text; that is now fixed.

If another PDF in the same batch is rejected by the API, other valid PDFs in that batch are no longer dropped from the conversation.

Typing `/goal clear` or a new `/goal` while Stop hooks are running and background work is still in progress now takes effect instead of being silently dropped.

items.original:
Fixed `/plan <description>` ignoring the description when plan mode was already on
Fixed valid PDFs being dropped from the conversation after the API rejected a different PDF read in the same batch
Fixed `/goal clear` or a new `/goal` not sticking when typed while Stop hooks were running and background work was still in progress

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮模型、30 MB 圖片與超額重試調整
title.en: Compaction models, 30 MB images, and limit retries

body.zh-TW:
在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測時進行對話壓縮，不再偶爾變成回覆你的訊息而非整理摘要，也不會漏掉 Claude 最後一則回覆。

在 Vertex AI 進行大量圖片的工作階段時，請求超過 30 MB 上限不再卡死在 400 錯誤，而是會先壓縮再重試。

設定的 `max_tokens` 超過模型上限時，Claude Code 會改用 Anthropic API 回報的最大值自動重試。規劃模式自動壓縮改用正在回答的模型（例如 `opusplan` 會用 Opus），成本可能增加。
body.en:
Compacting conversations on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry turned off no longer occasionally replies to your message instead of summarizing, nor does it leave out Claude's last reply.

During image-heavy sessions on Vertex AI, requests exceeding the 30 MB limit no longer get stuck on a 400 error, and instead compact first and retry.

When the configured `max_tokens` exceeds the model's limit, Claude Code automatically retries with the maximum value reported by the Anthropic API. Automatic compaction in plan mode now uses the model answering you (such as Opus with `opusplan`), which can increase costs.

items.original:
Fixed compaction on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry, and with telemetry turned off, sometimes replying to one of your messages instead of summarizing, or leaving Claude's last reply out of the summary
Fixed image-heavy sessions on Vertex AI getting stuck on a 400 error about the request size exceeding a 30 MB limit, instead of compacting and retrying
Fixed an error when `max_tokens` exceeded the model's limit: Claude Code now retries the request with the maximum the Anthropic API reports
Changed automatic compaction in plan mode to use the model answering you, such as Opus with `opusplan`, so it can cost more

title.zh-TW: 修正 /model 的 Default 選項顯示與切換
title.en: Fix /model Default option display and switching

body.zh-TW: 打開 `/model` 選單時，過去已存的模型常只顯示「Default (recommended)」，看不出方案預設究竟是什麼。現在 Default 會直接寫明你方案的預設模型名稱，在終端機選取它就能切回該預設模型。
body.en: When opening the `/model` menu, a previously saved model often only showed "Default (recommended)", making it unclear what the plan default actually was. Default now names your plan's default model directly, and selecting it in the terminal switches you back to that default model.

items.original: Fixed `/model` showing your saved model as "Default (recommended)": Default now names your plan's default model, and choosing it in the terminal switches you back to that default

title.zh-TW: API 重試倒數、claude -p 與網頁搜尋提示修復
title.en: API retry countdown, claude -p, and Web Search fixes

body.zh-TW:
伺服器回覆到一半出錯而重試時，寫到一半的回答不再靜止沒有轉圈提示；Web Search 重試期間也不會再一片空白。

API 重試提示在進入下一輪嘗試時不再卡在「Retrying in 0s」，會改為「retrying…」，遇到停頓或開啟減少動態效果時倒數也不再凍住。

使用 `claude -p` 重試超載或失敗的 API 請求時，或將純文字輸出重導向後發生失敗時，終端機現在會正常顯示狀態，不再靜悄悄沒反應。
body.en:
When retrying after a mid-response server error, a half-written reply no longer sits still without a spinner; Web Search also no longer shows nothing while retrying.

The API retry notice no longer gets stuck at "Retrying in 0s" when moving to the next attempt and instead changes to "retrying…", and the countdown no longer freezes when a reply stalls or with Reduce motion turned on.

When using `claude -p` to retry an overloaded or failing API request, or when a failure occurs after redirecting plain-text output, the terminal now displays status normally instead of staying silent.

items.original:
Fixed a half-written reply sitting frozen with no spinner while Claude Code retried after a mid-response server error
Fixed the API retry notice sitting at "Retrying in 0s" during the next attempt, now "retrying…", and the "will retry in" countdown freezing when a reply stalled or with Reduce motion on
Fixed `claude -p` showing nothing in the terminal while it retried an overloaded or failing API request, or when it failed with its text output redirected or captured
Fixed Web Search showing nothing while its request was being retried

title.zh-TW: /update-config 與 /doctor 輸出調整
title.en: /update-config and /doctor output adjustments

body.zh-TW:
終端機執行 `/update-config` 現在只佔約 13,000 個 token（AI 計算文字量的單位），過去約 93,000 個，被拒時也只引述改動項目。

Chrome 的 `browser_batch` 呼叫放寬到 150 秒（原 90 秒）；`/doctor` 改為邊檢邊報。

`claude plugin`、`mcp`、`update`、`doctor` 與 `auth logout` 統一終端機狀態標記並微調部分子指令措辭，管線與 JSON 輸出不變。
body.en:
Running `/update-config` in the terminal now uses about 13,000 tokens (the unit AI uses to measure text), down from about 93,000, and rejected edits only quote the changed items.

Chrome's `browser_batch` calls are extended to 150 seconds (up from 90); `/doctor` now reports findings as it checks.

`claude plugin`, `mcp`, `update`, `doctor`, and `auth logout` now use consistent terminal status markers and slightly adjusted subcommand wording, while piped and JSON output remain unchanged.

items.original:
Improved `/update-config` in the terminal to use about 13,000 tokens of context instead of 93,000, and a rejected settings edit to quote only the changed settings
Improved Claude in Chrome: a long `browser_batch` call now has 150 seconds to answer, up from 90, so fewer finished results are lost
Improved `/doctor` to share findings as it works instead of staying silent until the full report
Improved `claude plugin`, `mcp`, `update`, `doctor` and `auth logout` output on a terminal to mark success, failure and warnings the same way (piped output keeps its old form)
Changed the wording of some messages that `claude` subcommands print; JSON output is unchanged

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入、Windows Bash 與閒置效能加速
title.en: Terminal input, Windows Bash, and idle speedups

body.zh-TW:
長工作階段裡打字、串流輸出與調整視窗大小的反應都更流暢，讀寫檔案後的回應速度也更快，Windows 使用者感受尤其明顯。

工作階段閒置時喚醒電腦的頻率降低了，閒置時的 CPU 用量也跟著下降。

Windows 每個工作階段第一道 Bash 指令的啟動速度加快約 1 秒；在 git 儲存庫執行 `/compact` 後，第一則訊息的回應也更快了。⟦把辦公室電梯感應器重調過之後，沒人搭時不再空轉，人一踩進去關門起步也比以前快了半拍。⟧
body.en:
Typing, streaming output, and window resizing are all more responsive in long sessions, and response times after reading or editing files are faster, especially for Windows users.

Idle sessions wake the machine less often, lowering idle CPU usage as well.

On Windows, the first Bash command in each session starts up about 1 second faster; after running `/compact` in a git repository, the first message also responds faster. ⟦An office elevator with recalibrated sensors stops running unnecessarily when empty, and closes its doors and starts moving half a beat faster the moment someone steps in.⟧

items.original:
Improved typing, streaming and resize responsiveness, especially in long sessions
Improved response time after reading or editing files, most noticeably on Windows
Improved idle CPU use: an idle session now wakes the machine less often
Windows: Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command by about a second
Improved response time of the first message after `/compact` in git repositories

title.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 排隊與新工作階段加速
title.en: Faster Claude Desktop queues and new sessions

body.zh-TW:
在 Claude Desktop 等 Claude 回覆完時，先前排隊送出的訊息現在會更快得到回應。

開啟新的工作階段時，第一輪對話不再為了等隨需載入工具的本機 MCP 伺服器而多卡住最多 500 毫秒，開口就問就能馬上起跑。⟦去咖啡廳櫃檯點單時，不用等師傅把明天才要賣的豆子全部磨好，現點的這杯馬上就開始沖。⟧
body.en:
Messages queued in Claude Desktop while waiting for Claude to finish a reply now get responses faster.

When starting a new session, the first turn no longer stalls for up to 500 ms waiting on local MCP servers whose tools load on demand, so you can jump straight in. ⟦Ordering at a coffee counter no longer means waiting for the barista to grind all the beans for tomorrow first—the drink you just ordered starts brewing right away.⟧

items.original:
Improved response time in Claude Desktop for messages queued while Claude finishes a reply
Improved time to first response in Claude Desktop's new sessions: the first turn no longer waits up to 500 ms for local MCP servers whose tools load on demand

title.zh-TW: 啟動通知、失敗指引與終端機設定預告改善
title.en: Startup notices, failure hints, and terminal setup previews

body.zh-TW:
啟動時被收合的通知現在按 `Ctrl+O` 就能展開查看。請求失敗後若輸入框是空的，畫面上也會補上接下來該怎麼做的提示。

首次執行終端機設定時，過去做完不會說改了什麼或哪裡沒設成，現在都會交代清楚；而且終端機設定改在動手前就先列出全部變更項目。

初次啟動設定的主題預設值也從深色模式改為「Auto (match terminal)」，直接貼合你的終端機外觀。
body.en:
Collapsed startup notices can now be expanded with `Ctrl+O`. If the input box is empty after a request fails, a hint now appears telling you what to do next.

First-run terminal setup previously said nothing about what it changed or failed to set up, and now reports both clearly; terminal setup also lists every change before applying it.

First-run setup also changes the default theme from Dark mode to "Auto (match terminal)", matching your terminal's appearance directly.

items.original:
Added Ctrl+O to show hidden startup notices
Added a hint in the empty prompt that says what to do after a request fails
Fixed first-run terminal setup saying nothing about what it changed or could not set up
Improved terminal setup to list every change before making it
Changed first-run setup to preselect the "Auto (match terminal)" theme instead of Dark mode

title.zh-TW: 資料夾信任提示列出設定檔並擴及 --add-dir
title.en: Folder trust prompt lists settings files and covers --add-dir

body.zh-TW:
開機或用 `/cd` 換資料夾，Claude Code 會先問你信不信任這個資料夾；這個畫面現在會點名即將載入的專案設定檔（開機時還會標出會執行指令的檔案），若退出也會寫明原因。

已在受信任父資料夾底下出現信任提示時，按 `↑` 再按 `Enter` 不再誤選 Yes。

本機終端機工作階段用 `--add-dir` 或 `/add-dir` 加入未信任資料夾時會跳出信任提示，`claude --bg` 則直接拒絕。全螢幕 `/cd` 視窗太矮塞不下提示時，會拒絕選 Yes 並提醒拉高視窗。
body.en:
When launching or switching folders with `/cd`, Claude Code asks whether you trust the folder; this prompt now names the project settings files it will load (marking ones that run commands at launch), and explains why if it exits.

When a trust prompt appears under an already trusted parent folder, pressing `↑` then `Enter` no longer accidentally selects Yes.

In local terminal sessions, adding an untrusted folder with `--add-dir` or `/add-dir` now shows the trust prompt, while `claude --bg` refuses it outright. When a fullscreen `/cd` window is too short to fit the prompt, it refuses Yes and reminds you to make the window taller.

items.original:
Fixed Up then Enter answering Yes at the folder trust prompt shown under an already trusted parent folder
Improved the folder trust prompt, at launch and in `/cd`, to name the project settings files Claude Code will load; at launch it also marks files that run commands
Improved the folder trust prompt to say why Claude Code exited
Changed `--add-dir` and `/add-dir` in local terminal sessions to show the trust prompt for a folder you have not trusted yet; `claude --bg` refuses such a folder
Changed fullscreen `/cd` to refuse "Yes" while its trust prompt doesn't fit, with a line saying to make the window taller

title.zh-TW: 修正提示框吃字與誤觸 auto mode 的問題
title.en: Fix swallowed input in prompts and accidental auto mode

body.zh-TW:
設定結束時多按一次 `Enter` 不再誤接受將 auto mode 設為預設；對著啟動時的 auto mode 提議打字時，字不會再被吞掉，按 `Enter` 也不會誤同意。

在權限提示打了備註後若按 `Tab` 把它收起來，這個備註不會再誤送給 Claude。

畫面蓋著 `/sandbox` 或 `/permissions` 的刪除確認時，輸入英文字母也不會再讓選單選項亂跳。
body.en:
Pressing an extra `Enter` at the end of setup no longer accidentally accepts setting auto mode as the default; typing over the startup auto mode offer no longer drops characters, and pressing `Enter` no longer accepts it.

If you type a note on a permission prompt and then press `Tab` to hide it, that note is no longer sent to Claude by mistake.

Typing letters while `/sandbox` or a delete confirmation in `/permissions` is open no longer jumps the menu selection around.

items.original:
Fixed an extra Enter at the end of setup accepting the offer to make auto mode the default
Fixed a message typed over the startup auto mode offer being lost, and its Enter accepting the offer
Fixed a note typed on a permission prompt being sent to Claude after Tab had hidden it
Fixed letters typed over `/sandbox` or a delete question in `/permissions` moving the selection

title.zh-TW: 草稿復原、問答填寫與問題回報的輸入修復
title.en: Input fixes for draft recall, Q&A, and bug reports

body.zh-TW:
用連按兩次 `Esc` 清掉草稿再按 `↑` 叫回時，貼上的文字與圖片不會再不見。

修改回答後沒按 `Enter` 就切走，不再送出舊文字；回去看已答題目時，游標不再跳回首項導致 `Enter` 誤蓋答案。回到問題備註或用外部編輯器改寫後，打字游標也不會再跑錯位置。

在 `/feedback` 與 `/bug` 確認畫面按空白鍵不再直接送出，按 `Ctrl+O` 或 `Ctrl+Z` 也不會弄丟打好的內容。
body.en:
Pasted text and images are no longer lost when recalling a draft cleared with `Esc` `Esc` using `↑`.

Moving on after editing an answer without pressing `Enter` no longer sends the old text; going back to a previously answered question no longer puts the cursor on the first option where `Enter` overwrites your answer. Returning to a question's note or editing it in an external editor no longer lands the typing cursor in the wrong place.

Pressing Space on the `/feedback` and `/bug` confirmation screens no longer submits immediately, and pressing `Ctrl+O` or `Ctrl+Z` no longer loses what you typed.

items.original:
Fixed pasted text and images being dropped when ↑ recalls a draft cleared with Esc Esc
Fixed an edited typed answer to Claude's question sending the old text when you moved on without pressing Enter
Fixed going back to a question you answered from its list putting the cursor on the first option, where Enter replaced your answer
Fixed `/feedback` and `/bug` sending the report when you typed a space on the confirmation screen, and losing the typed report after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z
Fixed typing landing in the wrong place in a question's note after going back to it or editing it in an external editor

title.zh-TW: 游標定位與快捷鍵操作修復
title.en: Cursor Placement and Shortcut Key Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 `--add-dir` 或 `--allowedTools` 這類清單參數後面接著打的提示詞，不再無聲被吞掉。

貼上內容後馬上按 `Shift+Enter` 或 `Option+Enter`，現在會確實換行而不會誤送出。輸入文字自動換行時，按 `↑`、`↓`、`End` 或點擊滑鼠，游標也能對準正確那一行。

刪字或刪行後按 `Ctrl+_` 復原，不再遺漏最後打的幾個字；開啟斜線指令或 `@` 檔案選單時，改綁的 `chat:submit` 快捷鍵也能照常運作。
body.en:
Prompts typed right after list options like `--add-dir` or `--allowedTools` are no longer silently dropped.

Pressing `Shift+Enter` or `Option+Enter` right after pasting now adds a new line instead of accidentally sending the prompt. When typed text wraps, pressing `↑`, `↓`, `End`, or clicking with the mouse places the cursor on the right row.

Pressing `Ctrl+_` to undo after deleting a word or line no longer loses the last few words typed, and a rebound `chat:submit` shortcut still works while the slash command or `@` file menu is open.

items.original:
Fixed a prompt typed after `--add-dir`, `--allowedTools` or another list option being dropped without a message
Fixed Shift+Enter or Option+Enter pressed right after a paste sending the prompt instead of adding a new line
Fixed Up, Down, End and mouse clicks putting the cursor on the wrong row of a prompt that wraps
Fixed undo (Ctrl+_) losing the last words typed when pressed after deleting a line or word
Fixed a rebound `chat:submit` key doing nothing while the slash command or @ file menu was open

title.zh-TW: 貼上內容與長文字的顯示修復
title.en: Display Fixes for Pasted Content and Long Text

body.zh-TW:
貼進輸入框的程式碼與差異比較內容現在會保留縮排，新增行也不會誤標成刪除；自己輸入裡的 `src/**/*.ts` 或 `2*3*4` 等星號也不再消失。

貼圖後立刻打字，圖片預留標籤不會再插進字詞正中間；刪掉圖片標籤再用 `Ctrl+Y` 貼回時，圖片也能正常送出。

貼上送出或刪除後，展開貼上的提示不再擋住模式與中止提示；全螢幕模式下超過 10,000 字元的超長貼上也不再隱藏中段，打字超過這個長度也不會收摺起來。
body.en:
Code and diffs pasted into the prompt now keep their indentation, and added lines no longer show as removed. Asterisks in your own prompts, such as `src/**/*.ts` or `2*3*4`, also no longer disappear.

Typing right after pasting an image no longer puts the image placeholder in the middle of a word, and deleting the image placeholder then pasting it back with `Ctrl+Y` still sends the image.

After a paste is sent or deleted, the expand-paste hint no longer covers the mode and interrupt hints. In fullscreen mode, pastes longer than 10,000 characters no longer hide their middle section, and typing past that length no longer collapses the prompt.

items.original:
Fixed code or a diff pasted into a prompt losing its indentation in the transcript, and a pasted diff's added lines showing as removed
Fixed `[Image #N]` landing in the middle of a word when typing right after pasting, and a pasted image not being sent after deleting its placeholder and pasting it back with Ctrl+Y
Fixed asterisks disappearing from your own prompts in the transcript, such as `src/**/*.ts` or `2*3*4`
Fixed the "paste again to expand" hint hiding the mode and "esc to interrupt" after a paste was sent or deleted
Fixed "paste again to expand" hiding the middle of a paste longer than 10,000 characters in fullscreen mode, and a prompt collapsing while you type past that length

title.zh-TW: `!` 路徑補齊、Esc 誤觸與排隊提示修復
title.en: `!` Path Completion, Esc Handling, and Queue Hint Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 `!` 殼層模式下，沒帶斜線的檔名現在也能按 `Tab` 自動補齊，遇到空白或特殊字元時路徑還會自動加上引號。

在輸入框按住 `Esc` 清完文字後不會再順手開出 Rewind，也不會誤取消待執行的 `/loop`。若再按一次 `Esc` 已不會清除輸入，畫面的提醒文字也會跟著消失。

排隊中的訊息底下現在改標「Queued」，看起來不再像是你打的訊息本身。
body.en:
In `!` shell mode, pressing `Tab` now completes file names without a slash, and completed paths with spaces or special characters are automatically quoted.

Holding `Esc` in the prompt to clear text no longer opens Rewind afterward or accidentally cancels a pending `/loop`. If pressing `Esc` again will no longer clear the input, the on-screen reminder also disappears.

Queued messages now show "Queued" underneath so they no longer look like part of the message you typed.

items.original:
Fixed Tab not completing file names without a slash in shell mode (`!`), and completed paths with spaces or shell characters not being quoted
Fixed holding Esc over typed text opening Rewind after the text was cleared
Fixed Esc over typed text cancelling a pending `/loop`
Fixed "Esc again to clear" staying on screen after a second Esc would no longer clear the prompt
Improved the send-now hint under queued messages: it now says "Queued" and no longer looks like part of your message

title.zh-TW: iTerm2 快捷鍵與 /terminal-setup 修正
title.en: iTerm2 Shortcut and /terminal-setup Fixes

body.zh-TW:
透過 iTerm2 連 SSH 且 Option 鍵沒設成 Meta 時，按 `Option+T` 過去會打出「†」符號而無法切換思考模式，這個問題已經修好。

執行 `/terminal-setup` 時，現在會寫明 `Shift+Enter` 需要的 tmux 設定。對於 1.25 版之前的 Windows Terminal，也不再誤稱支援 `Shift+Enter` 換行，因為那些舊版按下去會直接送出訊息。
body.en:
Fixed `Option+T` typing "†" instead of toggling thinking mode when connecting over SSH from iTerm2 without Option set as Meta.

Running `/terminal-setup` now names the tmux settings that `Shift+Enter` needs. It also no longer claims Windows Terminal versions before 1.25 support `Shift+Enter` for new lines, since pressing it in those older versions sends the prompt.

items.original:
Fixed Option+T typing † instead of toggling thinking over SSH from iTerm2 when Option isn't set as Meta
Fixed `/terminal-setup` not naming the tmux settings that Shift+Enter needs, and promising Shift+Enter in Windows Terminal before 1.25, where it sends the prompt

title.zh-TW: 回覆串流掉字、捲動回看與記憶體配置修復
title.en: Reply Streaming, Scrollback, and Memory Allocation Fixes

body.zh-TW:
畫面繪製遇到單次記憶體配置失敗時，整個工作階段不會再直接結束閃退。

回覆剛開始串流時，對話紀錄不會再漏掉幾行或讓輸入框往上跳；串流進行中，長清單或程式碼區塊也不再少一行或跳動。

在傳統渲染器下，較長的排隊訊息不再於串流期間蓋住 Claude 的回覆，也不會從捲動紀錄中被抹掉。
body.en:
A single failed memory allocation while drawing the screen no longer causes the entire session to exit.

As a reply starts streaming, the transcript no longer drops a few rows or makes the prompt jump up, and long lists or code blocks no longer lose a line or jump while a response streams.

In the classic renderer, longer queued messages no longer cover Claude's reply while it streams or get erased from scrollback.

items.original:
Fixed a session ending after a single failed memory allocation while drawing the screen
Fixed the transcript dropping a few rows, or the prompt jumping up, as a reply started streaming
Fixed a line of a long list or code block going missing from scrollback, and text jumping a row, while a response streams
Fixed a long queued message hiding Claude's reply while it streams, and erasing it from scrollback in the classic renderer

title.zh-TW: 修正切換模型閃白、長檔卡頓與轉圈跳動
title.en: Fixes for Model Switching Blank Screens, Long-File Freezes, and Spinner Jumps

body.zh-TW:
在 `/model` 挑完模型不再畫面全白吃按鍵，用 `/model <alias>` 與 `/effort <level>` 切換時輸入框也不再短暫消失並漏接文字。

權限提示與 `Ctrl+O` 紀錄要顯示新建的長檔案時，或是遇到極長的 Bash、PowerShell 指令時，不會再讓工作階段凍結卡住好幾秒。

回覆結束與工具呼叫串流完成時，提示文字、「Reading 1 file…」與輸入框也不再閃爍或上下跳動。
body.en:
Picking a model in `/model` no longer blanks the screen and drops keystrokes, and switching with `/model <alias>` or `/effort <level>` no longer briefly hides the prompt and drops typed text.

Showing newly created long files in the permission prompt or `Ctrl+O` transcript, or running very long Bash or PowerShell commands, no longer freezes the session for seconds.

When a reply finishes or a tool call stops streaming, the spinner tip, "Reading 1 file…", and the prompt no longer flicker or jump.

items.original:
Fixed the screen going blank and dropping keys after picking a model in `/model`, and `/model <alias>` and `/effort <level>` briefly hiding the prompt and dropping letters typed right after
Fixed the screen freezing for seconds when showing long newly created files in the permission prompt and the Ctrl+O transcript
Fixed some very long Bash or PowerShell commands freezing the session for seconds
Fixed the spinner tip flashing back and the screen bouncing as a reply finished
Fixed the "Reading 1 file…" line blinking out and the prompt jumping when a tool call finished streaming

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲動定位、搜尋卡頓與提示框顯示改善
title.en: Fullscreen Scroll Position, Search Freeze, and Prompt Display Improvements

body.zh-TW:
在全螢幕模式往上捲動或回答 Edit、Write 提示後回覆完成時，文字不再亂跳，調整視窗大小也不會跑位或跳輪次。

長工作階段在搜尋或往回跳很遠時不再整片變白，快速捲動中途也不會卡死。

頂端固定的提問框串流時不再誤顯示舊問題，往上拖曳反白複製回覆時也不會連它一起複製進去。輸入框邊框現在還會直接標出長提示共有幾行落在視野之外。
body.en:
In fullscreen mode, text no longer jumps when a reply finishes while you are scrolled up or after answering an Edit or Write prompt, and resizing the window no longer loses your place or jumps turns.

Long sessions no longer go blank when searching or jumping far back, and fast scrolling no longer freezes partway through.

The pinned prompt at the top no longer shows an older question while a reply streams or gets copied when you drag a selection upward past the top. The prompt border now also shows how many lines of a long prompt are out of view.

items.original:
Fixed fullscreen text jumping when a reply finishes while you're scrolled up or after answering an Edit or Write prompt, and losing your place or jumping turns when resizing
Fixed the fullscreen transcript going blank when searching or jumping far back, and freezing partway through a fast scroll, in long sessions
Fixed the pinned prompt in fullscreen showing an older question while a reply streams, and being copied with the reply when you drag a selection past the top
Improved fullscreen mode: the prompt's borders now show how many lines of a long prompt are out of view

title.zh-TW: TUI 切換說明、滑鼠亂碼與預覽捲動修復
title.en: TUI Switching Details, Mouse Escape Codes, and Preview Scrolling Fixes

body.zh-TW:
長對話跑 `/tui default` 或另個視窗改 `tui` 設定時，畫面不再錯亂。若無法切回傳統渲染器，Claude Code 會直接指出是什麼設定鎖住了全螢幕。

新帳號第一個工作階段現在會跟後續使用同一種渲染器；離開全螢幕模式後，終端機也不會再被輸入一堆滑鼠跳脫字元。

在全螢幕模式下看 `claude --resume` 的工作階段預覽時，內容不再亂碼且能正常捲動。
body.en:
Running `/tui default` in a long conversation or changing the `tui` setting in another window no longer scrambles the screen. If it cannot switch back to the classic renderer, Claude Code now states which setting is keeping fullscreen on.

A new account's first session now uses the same renderer as later sessions, and exiting fullscreen mode no longer types mouse escape codes into the terminal.

Viewing the `claude --resume` session preview in fullscreen mode is no longer garbled and now scrolls properly.

items.original:
Fixed the screen scrambling after `/tui default` in a long conversation, or when the `tui` setting changed in another window (anthropics/claude-code#94879)
Fixed `/tui default` saying it had switched back to the classic renderer when a setting kept fullscreen on; after a `/tui` that can't switch, Claude Code now says what keeps the renderer
Fixed a new account's first session using a different renderer from later ones
Fixed mouse escape codes being typed into the shell after exiting fullscreen mode
Fixed the `claude --resume` session preview being garbled and not scrolling in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕工具計時、標題與指令輸出顯示修復
title.en: Fullscreen Tool Timer, Headline, and Command Output Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在全螢幕往上捲看舊訊息時，若有權限提示或問題在等你，畫面現在會發出提醒。工具群組標題也會正確顯示正在跑的呼叫，不再寫成已完成或排隊中的那一筆。

已完成的工具群組不再把搜尋或列目錄也計為殼層指令，工具計時器也不會把等權限或排隊時間算進去。

執行多行殼層指令時不再塞滿整個全螢幕；點開收合中的執行中指令列，現在也看得到即時輸出與計時器。
body.en:
When you are scrolled up reading older messages in fullscreen, the screen now alerts you if a permission prompt or question is waiting. Tool group headlines also correctly show the running call instead of a finished or queued one.

Finished tool groups no longer count searches or directory listings as shell commands, and the tool timer no longer includes time spent waiting for permission or in the queue.

Running a multi-line shell command no longer fills the entire fullscreen view, and clicking open a collapsed running command row now shows live output and its timer.

items.original:
Fixed fullscreen giving no sign that a permission prompt or question was waiting while you were scrolled up
Fixed the fullscreen tool group headline naming a finished or queued call instead of the running one
Fixed finished tool groups in fullscreen counting a search or listing also as a shell command, and the tool timer there counting time at a permission prompt or queued behind another command
Fixed a multi-line shell command filling the screen in fullscreen while it runs
Fixed a running command showing no output or timer when its collapsed row was clicked open in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: 改善指令即時輸出、跳到底部鈕與 Ctrl+O 提示
title.en: Live Command Output, Jump-to-Bottom Button, and Ctrl+O Hint Improvements

body.zh-TW:
執行 `!` 殼層指令時，開頭 3 秒鐘現在就會看到輸出，不再先空白一片。

全螢幕模式底下還有回覆內容時，跳到底部的按鈕不會再提早消失；矮視窗上方顯示問卷或通知時，輸入框也不會被擠不見。

全螢幕下打開 `Ctrl+O` 紀錄時，不再錯誤提示按 `Ctrl+B` 將指令放背景（該鍵在全螢幕是往上翻頁），並會清楚標出 Claude 還在工作中。
body.en:
Running `!` shell commands now shows output within the first 3 seconds instead of starting blank.

In fullscreen mode, the jump-to-bottom button no longer disappears early when more of the reply is still below, and the prompt no longer gets pushed out of sight when a survey or notice appears above it in a short window.

When opening the `Ctrl+O` transcript in fullscreen, it no longer wrongly hints to press `Ctrl+B` to background a command (that key pages up in fullscreen) and clearly indicates that Claude is still working.

items.original:
Fixed `!` shell commands showing no output for their first three seconds
Fixed the jump-to-bottom pill disappearing in fullscreen while more of the reply was still below
Fixed the prompt disappearing in short fullscreen windows while a survey or notice showed above it
Fixed the Ctrl+O transcript hinting Ctrl+B to background a command in fullscreen, where it pages up, and showing no sign that Claude is still working

title.zh-TW: 矮視窗與窄終端機的選單、錯誤不再被截斷
title.en: Menus and errors no longer cut off in short windows or narrow terminals

body.zh-TW:
在高度較矮的全螢幕視窗裡，`Ctrl+R` 搜尋、模型選擇器、計畫核准、問題預覽、背景殼層輸出與 `/plugin` 安裝選項過去容易被切掉，現在都能完整顯示。

在窄終端機裡，`/context` 網格與「Credit balance too low」、「Waiting for API response」等 API 錯誤與重試通知不再被裁斷或錯亂。連「esc to interrupt」與「Interrupted」提示也能完整對齊顯示。
body.en:
In short fullscreen windows, `Ctrl+R` search, the model picker, plan approval, question previews, background shell output, and `/plugin` install choices used to get cut off, and now display in full.

In narrow terminals, the `/context` grid, API errors such as "Credit balance too low" and "Waiting for API response", and retry notices are no longer cut off or jumbled. Even the "esc to interrupt" and "Interrupted" prompts align and display in full.

items.original:
Fixed the Ctrl+R search, the model picker, plan approval, question previews, background shell output and `/plugin` install choices being cut off in short fullscreen windows
Fixed the `/context` grid, API errors such as "Credit balance too low", "Waiting for API response" and retry notices, "esc to interrupt" and "Interrupted" being cut off or jumbled in narrow terminals

title.zh-TW: 自訂狀態列隨視窗縮放更新且不閃爍
title.en: Custom status line updates on resize without flickering

body.zh-TW:
自訂 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）在按 `Ctrl+C`、進入 `!` 殼層模式或貼圖時，不再突然消失或讓畫面跳動。

縮放終端機、執行 `/cd` 或 `/rename` 後，它會即時跟上新的寬度、資料夾與工作階段名稱，不再抱著舊資料不放。

狀態列旁的「esc to interrupt」提示也不再缺席；而當 `Esc` 其實是操作面板或頁尾項目時，它則會識相收起來。
body.en:
A custom status line (the status bar at the bottom of the terminal) no longer suddenly disappears or makes the screen jump when pressing `Ctrl+C`, entering `!` shell mode, or pasting an image.

After resizing the terminal or running `/cd` or `/rename`, it immediately updates to the new width, folder, and session name instead of holding onto stale data.

The "esc to interrupt" prompt beside the status line is no longer missing, and it hides itself when `Esc` actually targets a panel or footer item.

items.original:
Fixed the custom status line disappearing and the screen jumping on Ctrl+C, in `!` shell mode and while pasting an image
Fixed a custom status line keeping its old width, folder and session name after a terminal resize, `/cd` or `/rename` (anthropics/claude-code#107291)
Fixed "esc to interrupt" missing beside a custom status line and showing while Esc would go to a panel or footer item

title.zh-TW: 終端機工作狀態協定與進度條顯示修正
title.en: Terminal status protocol and progress bar display fixes

body.zh-TW:
使用支援 Program Status Protocol 的終端機，現在會把背景指令、監看與 MCP 任務也列進去，等待它們時會顯示忙碌而非已完成。

閒置壓縮後這類終端機不再誤報剛結束，透過 `claude agents`、`claude attach` 或 `--resume` 開的背景工作階段也有狀態可看。資料夾信任提示開著時，同樣會正確顯示等待你回應。

終端機進度條在等你回答或按 `Ctrl+Z` 暫停時不再假裝工作中，在 Ghostty 跑超過 15 秒也不會自己消失。
body.en:
Terminals that support the Program Status Protocol now also list background commands, monitors, and MCP tasks, showing as working rather than done while waiting on them.

After idle compaction, these terminals no longer falsely report a finished turn, and background sessions opened with `claude agents`, `claude attach`, or `--resume` now show their status. While the folder trust prompt is open, they also correctly show as waiting on you.

The terminal progress bar no longer pretends to be working while waiting for your answer or suspended with `Ctrl+Z`, and no longer disappears on its own after running for more than 15 seconds in Ghostty.

items.original:
Fixed Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) terminals showing a finished turn after idle compaction, or no status for background sessions opened with `claude agents`, `claude attach` or `--resume`
Fixed terminals that support the Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) not seeing Claude Code as waiting on you while the folder trust prompt is open (anthropics/claude-code#105801)
Improved Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) reports: background commands, monitors and MCP tasks are listed, and a session waiting on them shows as working instead of done
Fixed the terminal progress bar showing Claude as working while it waited for your answer or was suspended with Ctrl+Z, and disappearing in Ghostty after 15 seconds while Claude was still working

title.zh-TW: tmux 通知與繪製修復，免手動開滑鼠設定
title.en: tmux notifications and rendering fixed, no manual mouse config needed

body.zh-TW:
在開啟 `allow-passthrough` 的 tmux 環境內，或透過 SSH 連線 iTerm2 時，預設設定現在都能正常收到桌面通知了。

在 tmux 3.7 裡打字或顯示轉圈動畫時，不再每次都重繪整個窗格造成閃動。

全螢幕模式現在不用設定也能用滾輪捲動，因此原本提醒在 tmux 加上 `set -g mouse on` 的通知已經移除。
body.en:
Inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` on, or when connected to iTerm2 over SSH, desktop notifications now arrive normally on the default setting.

In tmux 3.7, typing or showing spinners no longer redraws the entire pane every time and causes flicker.

Fullscreen mode now supports mouse-wheel scrolling without extra setup, so the notice reminding you to add `set -g mouse on` in tmux has been removed.

items.original:
Fixed desktop notifications not being sent inside tmux (with `allow-passthrough` on), or to iTerm2 over SSH, on the default setting
Fixed typing and spinners redrawing the whole pane in tmux 3.7
Removed the tmux notice that said the mouse wheel needs `set -g mouse on` in fullscreen; the wheel scrolls without it

title.zh-TW: 修正中日韓粗體、Windows 路徑與寬表格排版
title.en: Fixes for CJK bold text, Windows paths, and wide table layout

body.zh-TW:
Claude 回覆裡的 Windows 路徑，在 `.claude` 或 `_build` 等資料夾前不再漏掉反斜線。日、中、韓文粗體若以標點開頭或結尾，也不再直接露出 `**` 符號。

計畫與子代理提示裡的寬表格不再散掉、長格旁的短字不再被腰斬，畫成標籤與數值清單時也不會冒出多餘字詞與空行。

指令與工具輸出裡的 JSON 清單末項和靠右對齊數字會保持縮排；差異比較裡的「No newline at end of file」也不再被算成一行程式碼而害後面行號全歪掉。
body.en:
Windows paths in Claude's replies no longer lose the backslash before folders like `.claude` or `_build`. Japanese, Chinese, and Korean bold text that starts or ends with punctuation no longer exposes raw `**` markers.

Wide tables in plans and subagent prompts no longer break apart or cut short words in half beside a long cell, and no longer show stray words and blank rows when drawn as label and value lists.

The last item of JSON lists and right-aligned numbers in command and tool output now keep their indentation. In diffs, "No newline at end of file" is no longer counted as a line of code, which used to shift all the line numbers after it.

items.original:
Fixed Windows paths in Claude's responses losing the backslash before folders like `.claude` or `_build`
Fixed bold text showing as raw `**` in Japanese, Chinese and Korean replies when it starts or ends with punctuation
Fixed wide tables breaking apart in plans and subagent prompts, cutting short words in half beside a long cell, and showing stray words and blank rows when drawn as label and value lists
Fixed the last item of JSON lists and right-aligned numbers losing their indent in command and tool output
Fixed diffs numbering "No newline at end of file" as a line of code, which shifted the line numbers after it

title.zh-TW: 修正主題配色、/usage 長條圖與表情符號對齊
title.en: Theme colors, /usage bars, and emoji alignment fixed

body.zh-TW:
部分主題與終端機的程式碼關鍵字、新增差異行、慢速轉圈與「thinking」不再難讀。主題與終端機背景色不同時，差異與檔案預覽裡的程式碼也不再消失。

在淺色與 ANSI 主題下，`/usage` 進度條未使用的部分不再看起來像滿格。

遇到膚色或組合表情符號、`✌` 與 `☝` 等符號，以及寬度較寬的印度語系母音符號時，後面文字不再錯位；GNU screen 裡組合表情符號也不再把整列推歪。
body.en:
Code keywords, added diff lines, the slow spinner, and "thinking" are no longer hard to read in some themes and terminals. Code in diffs and file previews no longer disappears when the theme and terminal background colors differ.

In light and ANSI themes, the unused portion of `/usage` progress bars no longer looks full.

Following text no longer shifts out of place after skin-tone or joined emoji, symbols like `✌` and `☝`, and wider Indic vowel signs; in GNU screen, joined emoji no longer push the whole row out of place.

items.original:
Fixed code keywords, added diff lines, the slow-reply spinner and "thinking" being hard to read in some themes and terminals
Fixed code in diffs and file previews being invisible when the theme and the terminal background differ
Fixed the unused part of `/usage` bars looking full in the light and ANSI themes
Fixed text being drawn out of place after skin-tone or joined emoji, symbols such as ✌ and ☝, and Hindi, Tamil and other Indic vowel signs in terminals that draw them wider
Fixed joined emoji pushing rows out of place in GNU screen

title.zh-TW: 收合工具列狀態標示與長輸出截斷檔案修復
title.en: Collapsed tool line statuses and truncated long output file notice fixed

body.zh-TW:
在展開檢視看長指令輸出時，若內容中途被截斷，結尾現在會直接附上完整內容的儲存檔名，不再無聲切斷。

收合起來的工具列在等待權限時不再誤寫成「Ran」或「Called」，呼叫被停止或拒絕後打開面板也不再重演「Running…」或「Reading…」。

失敗、被擋或被拒的指令現在會標「· 1 failed」或顯示未執行，不會再偽裝成成功。該輪失敗或被拒後不再印「done」列，技能與代理失敗時也不再卡在「Initializing…」。
body.en:
When viewing long command output in expanded view, if it is cut off mid-output, the end now includes the saved filename for the full content instead of cutting off silently.

Collapsed tool lines no longer mislabel themselves as "Ran" or "Called" while waiting for permission, and opening a panel after a call is stopped or refused no longer replays "Running…" or "Reading…".

Failed, blocked, or refused commands now show "· 1 failed" or say they did not run instead of looking like they passed. The "done" line no longer prints after a failed or refused turn, and failed skills and agents no longer get stuck on "Initializing…".

items.original:
Fixed long command output ending mid-line in the expanded view with no sign it was cut; it now names the saved file
Fixed collapsed tool lines reading "Ran" or "Called" while still asking permission, and "Running…" or "Reading…" again when a panel opened after a call was stopped or refused
Fixed failed, blocked or refused commands looking like passing ones in a collapsed tool line: it now shows "· 1 failed" or says they did not run
Fixed the "done" line showing after a turn that failed or was refused at a permission prompt
Fixed failed or refused skill and agent calls still showing "Initializing…"

title.zh-TW: 修正 /btw 捲動、/resume 與 Ctrl+R 搜尋
title.en: /btw scrolling, /resume, and Ctrl+R search fixed

body.zh-TW:
問 `/btw` 時若模型嘗試呼叫工具，現在會有明確通知，不會只留一句「Let me check that file.」。較長的 `/btw` 回答也不再假裝已捲到底，可以用 `PgUp`、`PgDn`、`Home`、`End` 與滾輪瀏覽。

在 `/resume` 搜尋較舊的工作階段不再誤報「No sessions match」，輸入數字時也會乖乖當作關鍵字搜尋而非直接打開工作階段。

全螢幕模式搜尋提示詞時，再按一次 `Ctrl+R` 現在會正確跳到更早的下一筆符合結果。
body.en:
When asking `/btw`, if the model tries to call a tool, you now get a clear notice instead of just "Let me check that file.". Longer `/btw` answers no longer pretend to be scrolled to the bottom and can be navigated with `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Home`, `End`, and the mouse wheel.

Searching for older sessions in `/resume` no longer falsely reports "No sessions match", and typing a number searches as a keyword instead of opening a session directly.

When searching prompts in fullscreen mode, pressing `Ctrl+R` again now properly jumps to the next older match.

items.original:
Fixed `/btw` showing only a lead-in such as "Let me check that file." with no notice when the model tried to use a tool (anthropics/claude-code#90314)
Fixed long `/btw` answers looking finished and ignoring PgUp, PgDn, Home, End and the mouse wheel
Fixed `/resume` search saying "No sessions match" for older sessions that exist, and a typed number opening a session instead of searching
Fixed pressing Ctrl+R again in fullscreen prompt search not moving to the next older match

title.zh-TW: 修正 /memory 唯讀警告與桌面版捷徑、提示誤判
title.en: /memory read-only warning, Desktop shortcuts, and prompt glitches fixed

body.zh-TW:
用 `/memory` 打開唯讀檔案時，現在會先警告修改可能無法存檔。在 Claude Desktop 請 Claude 改快捷鍵時，也不再誤改對桌面版無效的 `~/.claude/keybindings.json`。

在整合 Claude in Chrome 工具的應用程式（如 Desktop 的 Code 分頁）中，若組織政策停用了它，Claude 不再誤稱管理員可以幫忙開啟。

建議的下一句提問不再出現像 `<signal type="empty" />` 這種裸標籤；執行中滿 30 分鐘時建議輸入 `/clear` 的轉圈提示已經移除。
body.en:
Opening a read-only file with `/memory` now warns upfront that changes may not save. When asking Claude to change a shortcut in Claude Desktop, it no longer mistakenly edits `~/.claude/keybindings.json`, which has no effect in Desktop.

In apps that integrate Claude in Chrome tools (such as Desktop's Code tab), if your organization's policy disables it, Claude no longer mistakenly claims an administrator can turn it on.

Suggested next prompts no longer show bare tags like `<signal type="empty" />`; the spinner tip suggesting `/clear` 30 minutes into a running turn has been removed.

items.original:
Fixed `/memory` opening a read-only file with no warning that changes may not save
Fixed Claude editing `~/.claude/keybindings.json`, which has no effect in Claude Desktop, when asked to change a shortcut there
Fixed Claude saying that an administrator can turn on Claude in Chrome when your organization's policy disables it, in apps that provide its tools such as Claude Desktop's Code tab
Fixed the suggested next prompt sometimes being a bare tag, such as `<signal type="empty" />`
Removed the spinner tip that suggested `/clear` 30 minutes into a running turn

title.zh-TW: 輸入法搜尋、/effort 滑桿與快捷鍵清單修復
title.en: IME search, /effort slider, and shortcuts list fixes

body.zh-TW:
在 `/resume`、`/plugin`、`/permissions` 與 `/config` 搜尋時，現在能正常接收中文輸入法組字、語音聽寫與快速連打。

全螢幕下 `/effort` 的滑桿現在支援滑鼠點擊，跳出`Switch model?` 或 `Change effort level?`確認時也會顯示按鍵提示。

`?` 快捷鍵清單在窄終端機不再欄位重疊，矮全螢幕底部也不會被切掉。在 macOS 與 Linux 開啟螢幕閱讀器關閉 `/permissions` 搜尋後，不再留下殘餘提示文字。
body.en:
Search in `/resume`, `/plugin`, `/permissions`, and `/config` now properly accepts Chinese IME composition, voice dictation, and fast typing.

In fullscreen mode, the `/effort` slider now supports mouse clicks, and the `Switch model?` and `Change effort level?` confirmation prompts now show key hints.

The `?` shortcuts list no longer overlaps columns in narrow terminals or gets cut off at the bottom in short fullscreen windows. On macOS and Linux with a screen reader enabled, closing `/permissions` search no longer leaves leftover hint text behind.

items.original:
Fixed search in `/resume`, `/plugin`, `/permissions` and `/config` ignoring IME input, dictation and fast typing
Fixed the `/effort` slider ignoring mouse clicks in fullscreen mode
Fixed the "Switch model?" and "Change effort level?" questions showing no key hints
Fixed the `?` shortcuts list running its columns together in narrow terminals and being cut off at the bottom in short fullscreen windows
Fixed leftover hint text in screen reader mode on macOS and Linux after closing the `/permissions` search when the rule list was taller than the terminal

title.zh-TW: 對話框按鍵提示、輸入框換行與清單導覽改善
title.en: Dialog Key Hints, Text Field Wrapping, and List Navigation Improvements

body.zh-TW:
對話框與 `?` 清單統一按鍵提示順序並適應窄視窗，`/hooks` 與 `/permissions` 深層畫面也標明 `Esc` 返回。許多對話框的錯誤、警告與確認統一以 `✘`、`⚠`、`✔` 開頭，狀態列也更整齊。

`/add-dir`、`/export` 等多個設定與回報輸入框統一外觀且長字會換行，被拒的內容能原地修改。長選單與 `/`、`@` 選單也會標明上下還有幾列隱藏項目。

更多清單支援頭尾循環移動，斜線指令勾選清單支援 `Home` 與 `End`，`/permissions` 搜不到東西時也會主動說明。
body.en:
Dialogs and `?` lists now use a consistent key-hint order and fit narrow windows, and deeper screens in `/hooks` and `/permissions` show that `Esc` goes back. Errors, warnings, and confirmations in many dialogs start with `✘`, `⚠`, or `✔`, and status rows are neater.
